top_stories.title: Cisco warns of max severity ISE zero-day exploited in attacks
top_stories.summary: Cisco has released security updates to address a maximum-severity zero-day vulnerability in its Identity Services Engine (ISE) that is being actively exploited in the wild. Cisco ISE is a network access control and identity management platform widely used for authentication, authorization, and policy enforcement in enterprise environments.

top_stories.title: Cisco Warns of New Zero-Day ISE Auth Bypass (CVSS 10.0) Exploited in Active Attacks
top_stories.summary: Cisco has disclosed a maximum-severity (CVSS 10.0) zero-day vulnerability in its Identity Services Engine (ISE), tracked as CVE-2026-76460, that is actively being exploited in the wild. The flaw exists in an API endpoint with insufficient authentication controls, allowing unauthenticated remote attackers to bypass authentication entirely.

top_stories.title: The Gatekeeper Is the Door: Cisco ISE’s Nine-CVE Disclosure and the Identity Infrastructure Attack Surface
top_stories.summary: Cisco disclosed nine vulnerabilities in its Identity Services Engine (ISE), including multiple critical-severity flaws confirmed under active exploitation. The disclosure includes CVE-2026-76460, an unauthenticated REST API vulnerability, affecting a platform widely used for network access control and identity-based policy enforcement.

top_stories.title: Two Unauthenticated Lockpicks for the Enterprise Vault: Delinea Secret Server’s Double Critical Disclosure
top_stories.summary: Two critical unauthenticated vulnerabilities were disclosed in Delinea Secret Server, a privileged access management platform used to secure enterprise credentials. The flaws, disclosed on September 15, 2026, allow unauthenticated attackers to compromise the system, directly exposing sensitive privileged credentials stored within the PAM vault.

top_stories.title: NIST and CISA finalize playbook to stop token theft and forgery
top_stories.summary: NIST and CISA have finalized guidelines (NIST IR 858) targeting the protection of identity and access tokens from forgery, theft, and misuse, aimed at federal agencies and cloud service providers. The playbook addresses token security across authentication and authorization workflows, covering threat vectors such as token theft and assertion forgery.

news.title: Hardcoded MCP credentials found in public GitHub files
news.summary: Hush Security's research found that 12% of credential slots in approximately 82,000 publicly accessible MCP configuration files on GitHub contained hardcoded credential literals, including API keys and access tokens. The findings highlight identity security gaps in AI coding tool configurations where exposed credentials could provide unauthorized access to connected services and systems.

news.title: 98% of fraudulent hires have company credentials by the time they’re caught
news.summary: HYPR's State of HR Identity Fraud Detection report finds that 98% of fraudulent hires already possess company credentials by the time they are identified. The report highlights a 90-day hiring-to-onboarding gap as a critical vulnerability in enterprise identity security, where attackers obtain legitimate credentials through remote hiring processes rather than network breaches.

news.title: What Recent AI-Powered Attacks Mean for Your Identity Security
news.summary: Specops published analysis on how AI-powered attacks are accelerating credential theft and identity-based threats. The piece argues that identity security must extend beyond authentication to include device trust verification as part of a more comprehensive access control approach.

news.title: A fake ChatGPT billing email is after your OpenAI password
news.summary: A phishing campaign is using fake ChatGPT billing emails to direct users to a spoofed OpenAI login page that harvests their credentials. Cofense's Phishing Defense Center researcher Josh Varden identified the attack, which routes victims through a Google redirect to the attacker-controlled page targeting both work and personal accounts.

news.title: Druva expands identity resilience with ransomware detection
news.summary: Druva has announced expanded capabilities for its Identity Resilience product, including a new Ransomware Detection feature powered by a proprietary AI threat pipeline called Dru MetaGraph. The new offerings use behavioral intelligence to detect suspicious identity-related activity, confirm compromise impact, and support containment and recovery efforts.

news.title: Critical Check Point Management Flaw Lets Unauthenticated Attackers Run Code as Root
news.summary: A critical vulnerability in Check Point's Security Management and Log Servers allows unauthenticated attackers to execute code as root remotely. Check Point has released a fix via its LivePatch update channel and reports no known active exploitation of the flaw.

news.title: Okta CEO Todd McKinnon goes one-on-one with Jim Cramer
news.summary: Okta CEO Todd McKinnon appeared on CNBC's Mad Money with Jim Cramer to discuss AI agents, quarterly results, and the company's future. The conversation covered Okta's business performance and strategic direction around AI-driven identity.

news.title: Keeper Security、SailPointとの連携により特権アクセスガバナンスを自動化
news.summary: Keeper Security has announced an integration with SailPoint to automate privileged access governance. The partnership combines Keeper's privileged access management capabilities with SailPoint's identity governance platform.

news.title: Windows 11 KB5124008 update breaks domain trust for some users
news.summary: Microsoft's Windows 11 KB5124008 security update is breaking domain trust relationships on some enterprise systems. The issue prevents users from logging in with valid domain credentials, affecting enterprise authentication infrastructure.

news.title: N0va Phishkit Targets US and EU Businesses: A New Challenge for Identity Security
news.summary: A phishing kit called N0va is targeting organizations in North America and Europe by impersonating trusted services and abusing legitimate authentication flows to compromise user identities. The attacks bypass traditional malware detection by leveraging valid account credentials, enabling threat actors to access sensitive data and cloud business systems through a single compromised identity.

news.title: Active Exploitation Attempts Target WSO2 API Manager JWT Bypass With Forged Admin Tokens
news.summary: A critical vulnerability (CVE-2026-5430, CVSS 9.8) in WSO2 API Manager is being actively exploited in the wild, allowing attackers to bypass JWT authentication through improper cryptographic signature verification. The flaw enables account takeover via forged admin tokens, with exploitation attempts documented by watchTowr researchers.

news.title: KREMLIN Banking Malware Hijacks Chrome and Edge to Steal Credentials and Session Tokens
news.summary: Elastic Security Labs has documented a Brazilian banking malware called KREMLIN, tracked as REF9334, which hijacks Chrome and Edge browsers to steal credentials and session tokens. The malware uses browser extensions to target users of Brazilian banks by impersonating their login pages.

news.title: SailPoint (SAIL) Reaches $1.2 Billion ARR. Can AI Growth Lift Revenue and Cash Flow?
news.summary: SailPoint reported fiscal Q2 2027 revenue of $308.8 million, a 17% year-over-year increase, with annual recurring revenue reaching $1.2 billion. The company highlighted AI-driven growth as a factor in its financial performance.

news.title: CISA and NIST Issue Guidance to Protect Cloud Identity Tokens
news.summary: CISA and NIST have released final guidance aimed at protecting cloud identity tokens and assertions. The guidance targets a critical component of cloud authentication infrastructure used across identity federation and SSO implementations.

news.title: Quest Software Takes Aim at Rogue AI Agents as Identity Security Threats Drive 90% of Cyber Incidents
news.summary: Quest Software announced a major expansion of its Quest Security Manager platform, positioning it as a NIST-aligned identity security solution targeting AI agent-related threats. The platform is designed to expose identity risk, contain lateral movement attacks, and accelerate recovery of critical operations.

news.title: KuppingerCole Analysts Include Regula in the Leadership Compass for Its Identity Data Control and Document Verification
news.summary: KuppingerCole Analysts has included Regula in its 2026 Leadership Compass for Identity Verification, recognizing the vendor among leading identity verification providers. Regula was noted for its privacy-first approach to identity checks and document verification capabilities.

news.title: AWS STS simplifies session token size limits and adds session token size monitoring
news.summary: AWS Security Token Service (STS) has simplified its session token size limits by replacing the packed policy size and overall session token size limits with a single token size limit. The update also adds session token size monitoring, giving IAM practitioners more flexibility when working with session policies and session tags.

news.title: The Vendor Rush Is Here: Agent Governance Hits Its Tipping Point
news.summary: Major infrastructure vendors including Okta have reached a tipping point in agent governance, with four vendors shipping standalone agent governance products at general availability. Okta's July 2026 product innovations were highlighted as pushing furthest into new territory in this emerging category.

news.title: Architecting resilient authentication with Amazon Cognito multi-Region replication
news.summary: AWS published guidance on architecting resilient consumer identity and access management (CIAM) systems using Amazon Cognito with multi-Region replication. The article addresses authentication availability and continuity as businesses scale across geographies, covering replication strategies for user pools and authentication flows.

news.title: How Cisco is confronting the security crisis of agentic AI
news.summary: Cisco's VP of product for identity has flagged the widespread presence of unauthorized "shadow agents" in enterprise environments as a growing security concern. Cisco is addressing this through its Duo Agentic Identity product, designed to manage and secure agentic AI within identity infrastructure.

news.title: Operationalizing least privilege: Automate IAM remediation through your CI/CD pipeline
news.summary: The article addresses operationalizing least privilege in AWS environments by automating IAM remediation through CI/CD pipelines. It focuses on the practical challenge of permission sprawl during application deployment and proposes automated tooling as a solution for maintaining least privilege at scale.

news.title: EU Cyber Resilience Act to Enforce New Reporting Requirements
news.summary: The EU Cyber Resilience Act begins enforcing a 24-hour mandatory reporting requirement for serious product security incidents affecting European organizations. This regulatory change introduces new compliance obligations relevant to IAM and security teams managing access to critical systems and products.

news.title: Identity-Based AI Attack Threatens Security of Enterprise Data
news.summary: A new attack technique called "workflow identity hijacking" has been identified that can bypass standard security controls by exploiting unauthenticated entry points in enterprise environments. The attack targets identity-based weaknesses in AI workflows to gain unauthorized access to organizational data.

news.title: Microsoft Plugs Nearly 1,000 Security Holes
news.summary: Microsoft released a patch batch of at least 974 security vulnerabilities across Windows and other software, its largest ever. AI is being credited for accelerating vulnerability discovery, though security experts note organizations are struggling to prioritize and deploy the high volume of fixes.

news.title: FBI Probes Service Selling 153M+ Drivers Licenses
news.summary: A dark web service is selling digital scans of over 153 million U.S. and Canadian drivers licenses, allegedly sourced from a Louisiana-based identity verification company. The FBI's New Orleans field office has opened an official inquiry into the breach.

news.title: Canadian Man Pleads Guilty in Snowflake Extortions
news.summary: Canadian man Connor Riley Moucka pleaded guilty to computer fraud and conspiracy charges related to hacking and extorting over 165 organizations using Snowflake's cloud data storage platform. The attacks also resulted in the theft of call and text records belonging to more than 100 million AT&T customers.
